The programme journey

Support designed around
the whole person.

The programme combines household assessment, tailored livelihood pathways, coaching and market linkages—then uses evidence to adapt delivery.

Assess household conditions, aspirations, capabilities and local opportunities.

02

Plan

03

04

Track outcomes and use participant feedback to strengthen programme delivery.
